items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: And all, and Eddie Jackson, you see, when Eddie Jackson was playing in the brass band, you could hear him for miles

ctx.x: And the people used to follow the band from the startin' to the finish. That's right. From the startin' to the finish. You go all the way to the graveyard, okay, you go up to Gretna, they go, go to Gretna, and back, you see? And all, and Eddie Jackson, you see, when Eddie Jackson was playing in the brass band, you could hear him for miles, you see? That's right, yeah. And them youngsters really know why they had to say, oh, they, they, somebody had blocks from here. They know, because they used to hear him. They…
He came from over the river too, didn't he?
